messages:
faizal: dropping a short prototype for an 'undo' snackbar + preview snapshot when users change autoscale min/max or toggle burst. want quick UX + a11y eyes. figma: https://figma.com/file/undo-snackbar

jena: really like the safety net idea. quick question: does undo revert instantly or schedule a rollback? users care about billing windows.

otto: engineering: we can revert the UI optimistically and call a revert API. runtime will try to reconcile running jobs; billing is per-second so a revert within 60s minimizes cost. need API flag `rollback_on_undo=true`.

reema: accessibility note: the snackbar must be keyboard-focusable and have an accessible name. SR text should say what changed and that undo will revert config and estimate. e.g. "Autoscale min changed from 2 to 8. Undo available for 30 seconds."

design-bot: lint: color-contrast fail on .undo-action (link style); missing aria-live announcement for the snapshot update; toast not in DOM order after the form.

faizal: good catches. idea for snapshot: show a tiny inline diff summary in the toast: "Min 2➜8 · Max 8➜16 · Burst: off➜on" plus a small cost delta like "+$45/mo". keep it terse.

jena: prefer words for screen readers: 'Min changed from two to eight. Max changed from eight to sixteen. Burst enabled.' add a hidden SR-only span with that string.

otto: backend note: we can include a `forecast_snapshot` in the response so toast can show both $ delta and confidence. example: `{delta_usd:45, confidence:'medium'}`.

reema: keyboard behavior: when toast appears, focus should go to the toast's primary action 'Undo' so keyboard users can reverse quickly. but this can be jarring — make it configurable via `prefers-focus-snackbar` user setting.

jena: when users click 'Preview' in the toast should we open the impact overlay or just expand the inline snapshot? my vote: small inline expand to avoid modal fatigue.

faizal: agree. inline expand with a small chart + text summary. the overlay remains for full details if user wants to dig deeper.

design-bot: accessibility: ensure expanded inline content has `role="region"` and `aria-labelledby` pointing to a concise title. also announce via `aria-live="polite"` the forecast when it inflates.

otto: implementation detail: we need a debounce on rapid changes. if user rapidly increments min from 1 to 6, show only the final change in the toast and keep undo target as the previous stable saved config.

reema: good. also add a small 'Why this matters' link in the toast that opens a SR-friendly explanation: 'Higher minimum keeps more GPUs warm and may increase cost.'

jena: visual: ensure the undo action is a button (not just link) with visible focus ring and at least 44px tap target for touch. color contrast for button text needs AA.

faizal: telemetry ask: capture `undo_shown`, `undo_clicked`, `preview_opened`, `revert_completed` events with payloads so PM can measure forgiveness rate.

otto: and emit `forecast_confidence` along with the snapshot so frontend can tag numbers with 'Estimated' vs 'Exact'.

reema: one more a11y nit: toast timer should pause if user focuses it, and SR should announce 'undo available for 30 seconds' once when it appears.

faizal: summary of action items: 1) implement inline diff in toast + $ delta + confidence, 2) make toast keyboard-focusable and optionally autofocus (respecting user pref), 3) SR-only spelled-out change string, 4) debounce rapid edits and target revert to last saved state, 5) telemetry events, 6) pause timer on focus. I'll update the Figma and post new frame as 2134567906.

jena: i'll take accessibility review after the update. otto, please sketch the API shape for rollback_on_undo and forecast_snapshot.

otto: will post API snippet in the design notes. rough: `POST /api/config/update -> {applied_config, forecast: {usd_delta, confidence, details}}; revert: POST /api/config/revert?id=&rollback_on_undo=true`.

reema: thanks team. small copy tweak suggestion for toast: 'Autoscale updated — Undo (30s) · Preview' rather than generic 'Changes saved'. clearer.

design-bot: auto-lint pass pending after updates. remember to attach contrast check images. :white_check_mark:
